summary: Tested Employee self-reflection changes: 7 core GCFs only + optional 5-GCF section + ClearFormButton + other_gcf_comments persistence. Backend: wrote /app/backend/tests/test_other_gcf.py (4 tests — reopen+GET, PUT+persist, clear, 3-item). All 4 pass. Full regression suite (test_master_data + backend_test + test_other_gcf) = 68/68 PASS. Frontend: logged in as Alice, navigated to /app/cases/{id}/employee. Verified DOM: exactly 3 pillars, exactly 7 core GCFs with testids matching expected set {gcf-1-2,gcf-1-3,gcf-2-1,gcf-2-2,gcf-2-3,gcf-2-4,gcf-3-2}, none of the excluded five present. Optional section 'other-gcf-section' renders with exact header '(Optional) The LDC assessment will focus on the 7 core leadership capabilities...' and all 5 checkbox rows (other-gcf-1.1, 3.1, 3.3, 3.4, 3.5). emp-clear-btn present. Toggle reveals TextArea. Full submit-validation toast path could not be clicked through automation because the Emergent badge overlay intercepts pointer events on submit-form button (tooling issue — real users unaffected).

issues: Emergent 'Made with Emergent' badge (fixed bottom-right) overlaps the submit/save/clear buttons at 1920x1080 and intercepts pointer events during automated clicks. Not user-facing critical but blocks e2e testing. Consider adding bottom padding to the action bar or z-index layering for the form footer.

action_items: Optional: bump z-index / add mb-14 or pb-16 to EmployeeForm footer action bar so the Emergent badge doesn't overlay submit/save/clear during e2e tests.

Consider mirroring the 'min 2 / max 3' optional-count rule server-side in PUT /api/cases/{id}/employee-form validation (currently front-end-only — backend accepted 1-item and 4-item payloads in ad-hoc testing; harmless but inconsistent with UI contract).
critical_code_review_comments: gcf.js CORE_GCF_KEYS is canonical & correct (7 keys matching spec). OTHER_GCFS has 5 entries, also correct.
EmployeeForm.jsx toggleOtherGcf guards max-3 via both (a) toast on attempt-to-add beyond 3 and (b) disabled attribute on unchecked boxes when length>=3. Good belt-and-suspenders.
EmployeeForm.jsx submit() properly short-circuits on count===1 and on any selected GCF with empty comment — matches spec.
EmployeeForm.jsx clearForm() resets contributions, capability_responses, other_gcf_comments, overall_reflection and PUTs draft — then toasts 'Form cleared'. Matches spec.
ClearFormButton arms on first click with 3s window and label flips to 'Click again to confirm' — matches spec. Uses component-local state (not window.confirm) which is correct for iframes.
models.py OtherGcfComment persists gcf_key/gcf_label/comment. EmployeeForm model includes other_gcf_comments: List[OtherGcfComment]. Pydantic default_factory=list ensures missing field parses. Good.
Route handler for PUT /api/cases/{id}/employee-form correctly round-trips other_gcf_comments (verified by test_put_and_persist_other_gcf and GET round-trip). No _id leaks.

Minor: EmployeeForm useEffect re-maps capability_responses on every form-load, which is correct for Level change but could drop capability rationale edits that are mid-flight if reload fires during typing — not observed in this run.

success_rate.frontend: verified core DOM + testids; max-3 disable and submit toasts not clicked due to overlay — logic verified by code review

seed_data_creation: Persisted other_gcf_comments on Alice's case during tests: {1.1:'TEST initiative comment', 3.4:'TEST delivery comment'}, then cleared. Final state: other_gcf_comments=[{1.1,3.1,3.5}] from interactive UI toggle sequence. Alice's employee form remains in draft (reopened).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Only Employee form was deeply tested. Manager/Stakeholder/Panel/HR ClearFormButton testids (mgr-clear-btn/stk-clear-btn/panel-clear-btn/hr-clear-btn) were NOT clicked through UI due to time budget. The ClearFormButton component is shared and proven on Employee form; by inspection of the JSX imports it's wired identically on the other four pages. If deeper validation is requested, navigate as mary.mgr@ldc.io → case → manager form, as peter.panel@ldc.io → panel review, as hr.lead@ldc.io → HR summary, as stake.one@ldc.io → stakeholder feedback, and click the Clear button twice to observe 'Click again to confirm' + 'Form cleared' toast. Alice's case id for re-runs: 164148a5-809a-4573-8ce7-423b87fc1484. To re-edit Alice form after she submits, POST /api/cases/{cid}/reopen {form:'employee'} as admin first.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only a tooling friction: Emergent badge overlay blocks Playwright clicks on submit-form. Users clicking with a real pointer don't hit this because the badge is small and sits bottom-right; automation's centered click on submit-form button resolves a bounding box that overlaps the badge.
